items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Willie Humphrey, he'd chair me all around there. We're not teaching that band here.

ctx.x: Well, Louis Capard, he moved. He used to be on Roman Street. That's where I knew him from here, Roman. He's on, he moved. I'll send you his address next time. I sure will. I appreciate it.
Next time you get over, you can go to see him. But you can avoid that, because I'm going there pretty soon. I can use the phone, true Willie Humphrey. Yeah, yeah.
I had dinner with a woman for his son of the rest.
